title: Vanya and Field
statementMd:
Vanya decided to walk in the field of size $*n* × *n*$ cells. The field contains $*m*$ apple trees, the $*i*$-th apple tree is at the cell with coordinates $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$. Vanya moves towards vector $(*dx*, *dy*)$. That means that if Vanya is now at the cell $(*x*, *y*)$, then in a second he will be at cell ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4cd2e23d078c7836c5f66c3a76cb219288d09e57.png). The following condition is satisfied for the vector: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/04a4e7c6666583d8b8f8df9f9a3817be526a7e2b.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c8818210d7d81357d25a255f5d844014e5e7391.png) is the largest integer that divides both $*a*$ and $*b*$. Vanya ends his path when he reaches the square he has already visited.

Vanya wonders, from what square of the field he should start his path to see as many apple trees as possible.

## Input

The first line contains integers $*n*, *m*, *dx*, *dy*$($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *dx*, *dy* ≤ *n*$) — the size of the field, the number of apple trees and the vector of Vanya's movement. Next $*m*$ lines contain integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - 1$) — the coordinates of apples. One cell may contain multiple apple trees.

## Output

Print two space-separated numbers — the coordinates of the cell from which you should start your path. **If there are several answers you are allowed to print any of them**.

## Note

In the first sample Vanya's path will look like: $(1, 3) - (3, 1) - (0, 4) - (2, 2) - (4, 0) - (1, 3)$

In the second sample: $(0, 0) - (1, 1) - (0, 0)$
statementZhMd:
Vanya 决定在一个大小为 $*n* × *n*$ 个格子的田野中行走。田野中有 $*m*$ 棵苹果树，第 $*i*$ 棵苹果树位于坐标为 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ 的格子中。Vanya 朝向量 $(*dx*, *dy*)$ 的方向移动。这意味着，如果 Vanya 当前位于格子 $(*x*, *y*)$，那么一秒后他将位于格子 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4cd2e23d078c7836c5f66c3a76cb219288d09e57.png)。对于该向量，满足以下条件：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/04a4e7c6666583d8b8f8df9f9a3817be526a7e2b.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c8818210d7d81357d25a255f5d844014e5e7391.png) 是同时整除 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的最大整数。Vanya 到达自己曾经访问过的格子时结束行走。

Vanya 想知道，他应该从田野中的哪个格子开始行走，才能看到尽可能多的苹果树。

## 输入格式

第一行包含整数 $*n*, *m*, *dx*, *dy*$($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *dx*, *dy* ≤ *n*$)，分别表示田野的大小、苹果树的数量以及 Vanya 的移动向量。接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - 1$），表示苹果所在的坐标。同一个格子中可能有多棵苹果树。

## 输出格式

输出两个用空格分隔的数字——你应该开始行走的格子的坐标。**如果有多个答案，可以输出其中任意一个**。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vanya 的路径如下：$(1, 3) - (3, 1) - (0, 4) - (2, 2) - (4, 0) - (1, 3)$

在第二个样例中：$(0, 0) - (1, 1) - (0, 0)$
